import narwhals as nw

# Scan the parquet file lazily using polars backend
lf = nw.scan_parquet("events.parquet")

# Build and execute the lazy pipeline
df = (
    lf
    .filter(nw.col("status") == "ok")
    .select(["user", "duration"])
    .collect()
)

print(df)
